page: Amazon Web Services c6id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable 8375C processors. Featuring an x86_64 architecture, the instance delivers 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at clock speeds up to 3.5 GHz. The platform is paired with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, maintaining a 2:1 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Local high-speed storage is integrated directly via 5,700 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, complemented by a 38 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. There are no discrete hardware GPU accelerators bundled with this configuration.

Performance benchmarks demonstrate robust high-throughput parallel execution alongside solid vector processing. In multi-core assessments, the instance achieves top-quartile marks, scoring 92,880.51 in stress-ng and 17,815.0 in Geekbench multi-core tests, supported by 54 MB of L3 cache and AVX-512 extensions. PassMark evaluation highlights strong cryptographic throughput with an encryption score of 87,379.21 (top 10%) and an extended instructions score of 86,434.67. High-speed memory architectures support uncached read bandwidth of 326.43 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 136.44 GB/sec, driving 90.38 million Redis SET operations per second and 66.98 GB/sec in static web serving. Conversely, single-threaded metrics, including single-core stress-ng (1,892.78) and single-thread compression workloads, remain in the middle 50% tier. Large-model LLM generation also reveals expected CPU-bound limits, yielding 2.78 tokens per second on 70B parameter models.

From a resource-density perspective, the inclusion of 5,700 GB direct-attached NVMe storage alongside dense core allocation offers strong compute-to-IOPS efficiency without external block storage overhead. The configuration fits high-performance batch processing, software compilation with Clang, distributed analytics, data transformation pipelines, and high-throughput Redis or database operations requiring immediate scratch space.
description: Amazon Web Services c6id.24xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance powered by 48-core Intel Xeon 8375C processors delivering 96 vCPUs running at 3.5 GHz on the AWS Nitro System. Featuring an x86_64 architecture with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory, it bundles 5,700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and 38 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without discrete GPUs. Benchmark results emphasize exceptional parallel processing and cryptographic performance, marked by top-tier PassMark encryption and strong multi-core Geekbench and stress-ng scores. Memory throughput remains robust at over 326 GB/sec for uncached reads, driving 90.38 million Redis SET operations per second and 66.98 GB/sec web serving throughput. Single-threaded metrics and large-model LLM generation remain moderate, underscoring its design as a parallel compute and local I/O workhorse. It is suited for CI/CD compilation, distributed data processing, media rendering, and low-latency database workloads.
